description: This file declares utility functions related to resource management and user input handling within the Zilker SDK. It provides function prototypes for resource dumping, value retrieval, input reading, tokenization, and mode string conversion.

methods.name: getResourceDump
methods.description: Dumps all details about a resource into a newly allocated string. Caller is responsible for freeing the returned string.

methods.name: getResourceValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a resource, respecting sensitive resource markings. Caller is responsible for freeing the returned string.

methods.name: getInputLine
methods.description: Reads a line of input from the interactive user. Returns a dynamically allocated string that must be freed by the caller.

methods.name: getTokenizedInput
methods.description: Tokenizes a provided input line into separate tokens. Returns an array of strings which must be freed; the number of tokens is output via 'numTokens'.

methods.name: stringifyMode
methods.description: Converts resource mode flags into a human-readable string indicating permissions and capabilities.
